prompt: Order the steps for enabling 2FA with an authenticator app.
explanation: Setup runs app-first: get an authenticator, start in account settings, bind it by scanning, prove it with a live code, then bank the recovery codes — losing the phone without those codes is a support ticket.

options.text: Install a TOTP authenticator app on the phone
Scan the QR code with the app
Enter the six-digit code the app generates to confirm
